Task complete. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T3/solution.py`: reads `inputs/base/model.safetensors` via `safetensors.safe_open`, drops the 48 buffer tensors, casts the 64 named projection matrices to bfloat16 and upcasts everything else to float32, runs the four required assertions (64 bf16 tensors, layer-0 qkv is bf16, embed_in is f32, 196 total tensors) before writing anything, then greedily packs tensors into ≤256MiB shards (oversized tensors — the two 412MB-after-upcast embeddings — alone in their own shard) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran it once; verified independently afterward (196 tensors, 64 bf16, dropped buffers absent, qkv0 bf16, embed_in f32).
- Wrote `out/T3/REPORT.md` with the self-report, noting the embedding-tensor sharding surprise (upcast float32 size, not input float16 size, determines whether it needs its own shard).
